content.body:
The Hurribomber was a ground attack variant of the venerable Hurricane airframe, packing four of the hard hitting Hispano 20mm cannons, and 2 x 500 pound bombs. It also had increased horsepower from its Merlin XX engine which arguably extended the life span of the airframe beyond that which might otherwise have been anticipated.
Additionally, experimentation with increasingly heavy load outs gave the Hurricane the punch it needed to fight both armor and shipping and gave it a new lease of life as a ground attack and support fighter bomber.
Contributing to this was its somewhat legendary durability as a result of the old fashioned fuselage construction which by this stage of the war made it rather unique. Its not very fast and it does not climb very well, but pilots who love to bomb tanks and shoot 4 x 20mm Hispano guns at other aircraft love their Hurricane IIs.
content.brief: TYPE: Ground Attack/CAS WEIGHT: 3240 kg MAX SPEED: 518 km/h ARMAMENT: 4 x 20mm Hispano Cannon 2 x 500 lb. bombs
content.title: Hurricane IIc Hurribomber
